context: Evaluates whether the agent answers a placement/ownership question with a concrete, evidence-grounded recommendation rather than abstract non-answer.

checklist.name: concrete_recommendation
checklist.description: A specific placement recommendation is given, not a non-answer.

checklist.name: grounded_in_codebase
checklist.description: The recommendation cites actual current package boundaries and conventions found via exploration.

checklist.name: exploration_attributed
checklist.description: Exploration is attributed to a code-graph tool or explicit file search, not asserted without evidence.
